<thought>Search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic transformation that breaks a sulfonamide (forming a sulfonyl chloride and an amine). This corresponds to the forward reaction where an aromatic amine attacks phenylsulfonyl chloride, forming the sulfonamide and breaking the S‑Cl bond. Using the functional groups list, the broken group is an “acyl chloride” (covers sulfonyl chloride) and the formed group is “sulfonamides”.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["acyl chloride"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamides"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
